description:
Temporally-ordered DECRYPTED content view, optionally filtered by node_type + an ISO8601
    date range. Same plan schema as get_timeline. Content scope required (403 otherwise).

node_type.description: Only nodes of this type: entity, concept, decision, person, organisation, event, source or synthesis. Empty = all.
node_type.title: Node Type

valid_from_after.description: Only nodes valid from after this time (ISO 8601). Empty = no lower bound.
valid_from_after.title: Valid From After

valid_to_before.description: Only nodes valid to before this time (ISO 8601). Empty = no upper bound.
valid_to_before.title: Valid To Before

name: get_timeline_content
